goal: Prevent feeding stale or hijackable peer addresses into release seeds by dropping an unmaintained source
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Supports dropping the unresponsive seed source since it can be re-added later (fjahr)
Asks whether outreach to the domain maintainer yielded any feedback (fanquake)
Suggests adding crawler seed dumps to the seed generation sources instead (willcl-ark)

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because dropping abandoned seed sources keeps release seed lists clean and reliable
Avoids feeding stale peer addresses or risking poisoning if the unmaintained domain expires
